title: The termwise product of two etale hypercovers is a hypercover
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $U_\bullet\to X$ and $V_\bullet\to X$ be augmented simplicial objects in the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of $X$ (augmented simplicial $X$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover] with all terms etale over $X$) whose degree-$n$ maps $U_n\to M_n(U)$, $V_n\to M_n(V)$ to their matching schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover] are etale coverings (surjective etale morphisms) for every $n\geq0$. Let $W_\bullet$ be the augmented simplicial object with degree-$n$ term the fibre product $W_n=U_n\times_XV_n$ [def-pc-fibre-product], face and degeneracy maps the induced morphisms $d_i\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}d_i$, $s_i\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}s_i$, and augmentation the structure morphism $W_0\to X$. Then $W_\bullet$ is an augmented simplicial object of the small etale site of $X$ whose maps $W_n\to M_n(W)$ are etale coverings for every $n\geq0$ (an etale hypercover of $X$), and the two termwise projections $W_\bullet\to U_\bullet$, $W_\bullet\to V_\bullet$ are morphisms of augmented simplicial $X$-schemes.

source.place: Lemma 01GI (lemma-product-hypercoverings), statement and proof; the covering-pullback argument is Lemma 01GH (lemma-funny-gamma)

proof.text: Fix n and unpack the degree-n matching objects MU and MV, their projections, matching maps, and universal properties from the two IsEtaleHypercover hypotheses. Evaluation of simplicial objects preserves binary products, and the etale forgetful functor preserves finite limits. Thus the projections of the chosen simplicial product form a binary-product cone in both X.Etale and Over X. Take MU × MV in X.Etale and define its lower-simplex projections by the binary-product universal property. Naturality of the simplicial product projections and the two matching compatibilities prove their compatibility after both product projections.

For every test object T of Over X, project a compatible matching cone for U × V to cones for U and V. Their matching universal properties give unique arrows fU and fV. The preserved binary product combines them into the required unique arrow to the image of MU × MV. Both the factorization equations and uniqueness follow by the binary-product hom_ext principle, using the equations of fU and fV. Define the matching map as prod.lift of the degree-n product projections followed by the given matching maps; the same projection calculation proves its simplicial operator equations. This constructs the matching object directly, so no separate matching-object fibre-product theorem is needed.

Convert the two limiting binary fans in Over X (the degree-n term and MU × MV) to scheme pullback squares using Over.isPullback_of_binaryFan_isLimit. Under their isoPullback isomorphisms the matching map is the pullback.map of the two given surjective matching maps, as checked after the two pullback projections. Mathlib MorphismProperty.pullbackMap applies surjectivity under base change and composition, giving surjectivity of this map. Composition with the two comparison isomorphisms preserves surjectivity; the latter composition is the matching map. Morphisms in X.Etale are already etale. The construction works for every n including zero and proves the hypercover condition.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 01GI, direct verification using the two-base-change and composition argument of Lemma 01GH. Matching universal properties are constructed explicitly in Lean; the surjectivity step uses Mathlib MorphismProperty.pullbackMap.
